item.title: October Lantern 0.6.14
item.description:
Add images to Ask Lantern (Mac)

  • Paste a screenshot or image (⌘V), drop one on the box, or pick with the paperclip. Up to 6 on a message.
  • Lantern's answer sees the first image. An agent it starts gets them all, and replies to a running agent include them too.

Your chats stay put

  • If one saved chat can't be read, Lantern now skips just that one instead of losing the whole list, and keeps a copy of the file.

Ask Lantern always opens (Mac)

  • If Lantern's panel ever goes missing, clicking its button brings it back. You no longer need to quit Lantern.
  • Only one copy of Lantern runs at a time. Opening it again brings up Ask Lantern.

Also

  • Send Logs now includes more of what Lantern itself did, to help us fix problems faster.

The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
